'''Shōotsuge''' (小乙下) was a {{ill|Rank within the cap Rank system|ja|冠位|1=Transition of Crown and Court Ranks|lt=Crown Rank|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rank within the cap Rank system|13=User:Immanuelle/Transition of Crown and Court Ranks|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 冠位・位階制度の変遷}} used in Japan from {{ill|649|en|649|qid=Q31117|lt=649|1=649}} to {{ill|685|en|685|qid=Q33480|lt=685|1=685}}. The Rank's position within the hierarchy changed after {{ill|664|en|664|qid=Q30621|lt=664|1=664}}, making it either the second or third lowest Rank. Initially positioned below {{ill|Shōotsujō|ja|小乙上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōotsujō|1=Shōotsu-jō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11458808}} and above {{ill|Risshin|ja|立身|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Risshin|1=Risshin|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11598243}}, it later Ranked below {{ill|Shōotsuchū|ja|小乙中|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōotsuchū|1=Shōotsu-chū|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11458809}} and above {{ill|Daiken|ja|大建|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Daiken|1=Daiken|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11435403}}.

== Overview ==
The Rank was introduced in {{ill|Taika (era)|en|Taika (era)|qid=Q1077930|lt=Taika|1=Taika (era)}} 5 (649) as part of the {{ill|19 Cap Rank System|ja|冠位十九階|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/19 Cap Rank System|qq=}}, splitting the former {{ill|Shōkoku|ja|小黒|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōkoku|1=shoukoku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11464511}} Rank into {{ill|Shōotsujō|ja|小乙上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōotsujō|1=Shōotsu-jō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11458808}} and Shōotsuge<ref>『日本書紀』大化5th year （649th year ）2月条。</ref>. Shōotsuge was the 18th Rank out of 19, positioned just above {{ill|Risshin|ja|立身|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Risshin|1=Risshin|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11598243}}.

In the 3rd year of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|en|Emperor Tenji|qid=Q314802|lt=Emperor Tenji|1=Emperor Tenji}} (664), the {{ill|26 Cap Rank System|ja|冠位二十六階|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/26 Cap Rank System|1=26-Rank cap system|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17209277}} was established, subdividing Shōotsu into three levels: upper, middle, and lower. Shōotsuge became the 24th Rank out of 26, just above {{ill|Daiken|en|Daiken|qid=Q108423490|lt=Daiken|1=Daiken}}.

The Rank was abolished in the 14th year of {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|en|Emperor Tenmu|qid=Q335181|lt=Emperor Tenmu|1=Emperor Tenmu}} (685) with the introduction of the {{ill|48 Cap Rank System|ja|冠位四十八階|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/48 Cap Rank System|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579719|1=48 Cap Rank System}}.

== Individuals Holding the Rank ==
The {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki|1=Nihon Shoki}} mentions several individuals who held the Shōotsuge Rank:
* '''{{ill|Tajihi no Hinamori|ja|他田日奉部忍|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tajihi no Hinamori|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''': Served as a minor official (Shōryō) of {{ill|Kaijō District, Chiba|en|Kaijō District, Chiba|qid=Q6347746|lt=Kaijo District|1=Kaijō District, Chiba}} in Shimōsa Province during Emperor Kōtoku's reign.
* '''{{ill|Mibu no Maro|ja|壬生麿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mibu no Maro|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 壬生麻呂|1=Mibu no Maro|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q109287708}}''': Recognized in {{ill|Hakuchi (era)|en|Hakuchi (era)|qid=Q540118|lt=Hakuchi|1=Hakuchi (era)}} 4 (653) as Ibaraki no Kuni no Miyatsuko, involved in founding Namekata District.
* '''{{ill|Nakatomi no Hitooshio|ja|中臣間人老|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nakatomi no Hitooshio|1=nakatominohashihito no oyu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q66365122}}''': Mentioned in Hakuchi 5 (654) as part of a Tang envoy delegation.
* '''{{ill|Saniguna|ja|沙尼具那|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saniguna|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''': An Emishi chieftain who surrendered in Saimei 4 (658) and became a district official (served as chief of Numusari Fort).
* '''{{ill|Aobiru|ja|青蒜|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Aobiru|1=Aohiru|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11662754}}''': Another Emishi leader from Saimei 4 (658), later appointed as a minor official in Tsugaru (served as minor official of Tsukisara Castle).
* {{ill|Fort Lord|ja|柵造|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fort Lord|1=ki no miyatsuko|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17990352}}: Promoted on Saimei 4 (658), chief of Tsukisara Castle.
* '''{{ill|Ōtomo no Inazumi|ja|大伴稲積|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo no Inazumi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579720|1=Ōtomo no Inazumi}}''': Recognized for constructing the Nunozashi Palisade in Saimei 4 (658).
* '''{{ill|Ue no Mitsuchichi|ja|上光父|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ue no Mitsuchichi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}''': Assigned to Tanegashima as a minor envoy in Tenmu 8 (679).

== Shōotsuge in Mokkan (Wooden Tablets) ==
Two mokkan (wooden tablets) mentioning the Rank Shōotsuge have been excavated from the {{ill|Asuka Palace Site|ja|飛鳥京跡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Asuka Palace Site|1=Asuka-kyō Ruins|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11665955}}:
- One found in the 51st excavation (1975) contains the phrase "Shōotsuge Rank" and is dated to 649–664 based on associated Ranks. It was inscribed alongside tablets with {{ill|Shōsanjō|ja|小乙上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shōotsujō|1=Shōotsu-jō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11458808}} and other Ranks.<ref>Nitō, Atsushi. "Capitals of Asuka and Fujiwara," pp. 100–102.</ref>
- Another found in the 104th excavation (1984) includes the term "Shōotsuge" along with references to "Daiken" and the year "辛巳" (681), which corresponds to Tenmu 10 and also had an intercalary month.<ref>Nitō, Atsushi. "Capitals of Asuka and Fujiwara," p. 104.</ref>
